# Mod API: Files, Store, and State

`$.fs` reads and writes files as the Claude Code process.
`$.store` keeps values of the plugin between sessions.
`$.state` holds named values with versions during a session.
A render hook that reads a state value is drawn again when the value changes.
Example: `const readme = await $.fs.read("README.md")`, then `await $.store.set("count", 1)`.
Limits: one file is at most 4 MiB, and `$.store` holds at most 4 MiB of JSON.

In the "Where" column, **Run time** means in a hook, in a closure that a hook drew, or in a timer callback.
It does not mean inside `register`.

| ✅ | `atom` | A named value with its initial: `read` answers the initial while nothing is written, so never `undefined`. Pure, runs in the plugin's environment. | Imported from `claude-code`. Type `AtomFunction`. | Module code. Pure helpers. | `atom` line 15413, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `derive` | A value computed from atoms and references, cached by their versions. | Imported from `claude-code`. Type `DeriveFunction`. Example: `const busy = derive([workers], list => list.filter(w => w.isBusy).length)`. | Module code. Pure helpers. | `derive` line 15421, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `memberOf` | A family's member for the instance being drawn, keyed by `e.requestId`. | Imported from `claude-code`. Type `MemberOfFunction`. Example: `const open = await read($, memberOf(isOpen, e))`. | Module code. Pure helpers. | `memberOf` line 15429, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `read` | Reads an atom, a derived value or a reference through `$.state.get`, while a `ui.render` hook draws, that subscribes the drawing. | Imported from `claude-code`. Type `ReadFunction`. Example: `const n = await read($, count)`. | Module code. Pure helpers. | `read` line 15438, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |

Type `UpdateFunction`. Example: `<Button key="more" onPress={() => update($, count, n => n + 1)} />`. | Module code. Pure helpers. | `update` line 15447, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
